body:
### Context

`@link-foundation/ui-store` has six operations (`insert`, `remove`, `move`, `setProp`, `removeProp`, `rename`, see `packages/ui-store/src/ops.js`). None of them changes the **positional values** of an element, for example `'Hello'` in `(greeting: text 'Hello')`.

`@link-foundation/ui-config` (#18, PR #100) applies configuration changes to a store with `bindStore`. When a user override changes positional values (`set('user', 'greeting', 'text', ['Hello, agents'])`), `bindStore` must remove the element and insert a copy with the same IDs and children, inside one transaction (`setPositional` in `packages/ui-config/src/bind-store.js`). That works, but the store then emits `remove` + `insert` events for the element and its whole subtree, the log holds a full copy of the subtree, and renderers rebuild the subtree for a one-value change.

### Goal

A store operation that sets the positional values of one element, so a positional change is one `update` event and one log op.

### In scope

1. Operation `{ op: 'setPositional', id, values }` in `packages/ui-store/src/ops.js`, with its inverse (`setPositional` with the old values) for undo/redo.
2. Store method `setPositional(id, values)` and the `index.d.ts` declaration.
3. Event: `type: 'update'` with `prop` left out (or a documented marker), `before`/`after` the old/new positional values.
4. Log LiNo form `(setPositional ID VALUES…)` in `packages/ui-store/src/log-lino.js`, read and written through ui-core `parseLinks`/`formatLinks`.
5. `packages/ui-config/src/bind-store.js`: replace the remove-and-insert workaround (marked `TODO`) with the new operation.

### Out of scope

- Positional values of anonymous elements in other packages.
- IndexedDB persistence (#17).

### Dependencies

#16 (closed).

### Step-by-step plan

1. Add the op, its validation and inverse in `ops.js`; add the method in `store.js`.
2. Add the log form and its reader.
3. Add tests (see below); update `packages/ui-store/README.md` (operation table).
4. Use it in `ui-config` `bindStore` and drop `subtree()`/`setPositional()` there.
5. Add a changeset (`@link-foundation/ui-store: minor`, `@link-foundation/ui-config: patch`).

### Files to create or change

`packages/ui-store/src/{ops.js,store.js,log-lino.js,index.d.ts}`, `packages/ui-store/README.md`, `packages/ui-store/tests/*.test.js`, `packages/ui-config/src/bind-store.js`, `packages/ui-config/tests/bind-store.test.js`, `.changeset/<name>.md`.

### Acceptance criteria

- `store.setPositional('greeting', ['Hi'])` changes `store.get('greeting').positional` to `['Hi']`, emits exactly one `update` event, and `store.undo()` restores the old values.
- `logToLino` / `logFromLino` round-trip a `setPositional` op; `replay` reproduces it.
- In ui-config, `config.set('user', 'greeting', 'text', ['Hi'])` on a bound store gives one transaction with origin `config` containing one `setPositional` op and no `remove`/`insert` events.
- `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run check:duplication` pass.

### How to verify

```
node --test packages/ui-store/tests/*.test.js packages/ui-config/tests/bind-store.test.js
npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:duplication
```

### Prior art and libraries

Yjs `Y.Array` replace, Automerge `splice` on a list field: one change for a value edit instead of a delete + insert of the parent.

### References

- #16 ui-store, #18 ui-config, PR #100 (`bindStore`).

### Requirements

R3, R9 (docs/ROADMAP.md).

ui store should use doublets-web, and other storages (including indexed db + local storage + links notation, and also database on top of sqlite in the browser and so on but implementing the same interface as doublets-web).

So we can experiment with all different storages at the same time, but all of them must become associative, storing and transforming links using substitution.

Use github.com/link-foundation/link-cli and other associative implementations for reference.

We also should support mini-links and deep client like in https://github.com/deep-foundation to implement similar to meteor (where it was mongo + mini mongo) experience, where it is not only possible to safe data partially locally, it should also make changing data seamlessly, and in sync with backed if present.

That means we need to have ability to write server and client schemas, and they are joined into single network on client (partially loaded), and also server.

So client works with links like they all local, yet data actually streamed from server based on what client's user actually have access to.

We can draft example server implementation here for configurable permissions like in deep-foundation, yet there we have permissions on triples, here we need to have permission on doublets, using type system as in link-cli:

Type -> SubType
SubType -> SubType
SubType -> Value

It actually all types, but it is infinitely recursive and can support multiple inheritance.

We also need to create issue at github.com/link-foundation/link-cli to optionally have permission layer implementation, which will support permissions stored in links themselves (in same or saparate links file as per configuration) to provide support for giving users only access to links, they can access.

Otherwise we should adapt associative architecture of https://github.com/deep-foundation and https://habr.com/ru/companies/deepfoundation/articles/656879

But instead of triplets, we need to support doublets.

We also need to create separate issue in  github.com/link-foundation/link-cli so we can create compatibility layer of triplets stored in doublets, providing similar associative API, so later we will be able to support not only doublets architecture, but also triplets architecture.

We should update the roadmap here, and in link-cli, so as the result we should be able to fully implement client and server side support for associative architecture in both doublets and triplets.

In this issue, we should focus on easy win - doublets implementation of client and server side (MVP), all other issues should be created here and inEve  github.com/link-foundation/link-cli so we will be able to fully deliver the vision.

Triplets implementation should be served directly via links notation (text + binary) API similar to how we do with doublets, but also with Hasura reimplementation of Deep Standard, so the UI of deep-foundation would able to connect to github.com/link-foundation/link-cli as a server, and compatibility will be preserved. Deep packages are surely optional layer and so on.

Everything should be implemented using decorators, replaceable modules and so on.

But here in this issue we are focus on just enough implementation here (including server) to test everything on native doublets protocol, everything ourside this scope must be planned with issues with blockers and so on.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.

title: ui-store: setPositional operation for the positional values of an element
